; Quick Notes corner fan for reMarkable Paper Pro Move
; ------------------------------------------------------------
; Tap the bottom-left corner with a finger -> a quarter-circle fan of up to 5
; pinned notebooks pops up. Tap one to open it. A "+" bubble appears while
; fewer than 5 are pinned; it opens a picker of your existing notebooks.
; Press and hold a bubble for Rename / Remove. Renaming uses a built-in
; on-screen keyboard; the label is stored only in Quick Notes (the notebook
; keeps its own name). Bubbles stay centred on the arc as you add more.
;
; Pen input passes straight through the corner (finger taps only).
;
; Pins are stored in /home/root/.local/share/quicknotes/slots.json
;
; Requires: xovi + qt-resource-rebuilder + qt-command-executor
; Plaintext identifiers resolve via the hashtab built by xovi/rebuild_hashtable.
; Tested on 3.28.0.172. The 3.29 lines are prepared for the next update and are
; untested: on 3.29 notebooks open through windowNavigator ("legacydevice/window/main").

VERSION 3.28.0.172
VERSION 3.29.0.148
VERSION 3.29.1.0

AFFECT /qml/device/view/main/MainView.qml
    IMPORT net.asivery.CommandExecutor 1.0

    TRAVERSE ?#root
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            CommandExecutor {
                id: qnExec
            }

            Timer {
                id: qnBootTimer
                interval: 800
                running: true
                repeat: false
                onTriggered: {
                    var host = root.Window.window ? root.Window.window.contentItem : root;
                    for (var i = 0; i < host.children.length; i++) {
                        if (host.children[i].objectName === "quickNotesOverlay") return;
                    }
                    var o = qnOverlayComp.createObject(host, {});
                    console.log("[quicknotes] overlay created: " + !!o
                        + " explorer=" + (typeof root.explorer)
                        + " windowNavigator=" + (typeof root.windowNavigator)
                        + " LibraryController=" + (typeof LibraryController));
                }
            }

            Component {
                id: qnOverlayComp

                Item {
                    id: qn
                    objectName: "quickNotesOverlay"
                    anchors.fill: parent
                    z: 999999

                    readonly property int maxSlots: 5
                    readonly property string dataDir: "/home/root/.local/share/quicknotes"
                    readonly property string slotsFile: dataDir + "/slots.json"
                    readonly property string xochitlDir: "/home/root/.local/share/remarkable/xochitl"

                    readonly property real unit: Math.min(width, height) / 10
                    readonly property real hotspot: unit * 0.85
                    readonly property real bubble: unit * 1.2
                    readonly property real fanRadius: unit * 3.3

                    property bool open: false
                    property int menuIndex: -1
                    property int renameIndex: -1
                    property string draft: ""
                    property bool shiftOn: true
                    readonly property int maxLabel: 24
                    readonly property real arcStep: Math.PI / 10
                    property bool pickerOpen: false
                    property var slots: []

                    readonly property int bubbleCount: {
                        return slots.length + (slots.length < maxSlots ? 1 : 0);
                    }

                    // ---------- shell helpers ----------
                    function run(cmd, args) {
                        try {
                            var r = qnExec.executeCommand(cmd, args);
                            if (typeof r === "string") r = JSON.parse(r);
                            return r || { stdout: "", stderr: "" };
                        } catch (e) {
                            console.log("[quicknotes] command failed: " + e);
                            return { stdout: "", stderr: "" + e };
                        }
                    }

                    function loadSlots() {
                        var r = run("cat", [slotsFile]);
                        var list = [];
                        try { list = JSON.parse(r.stdout || "[]"); } catch (e) { list = []; }
                        if (!Array.isArray(list)) list = [];
                        slots = list.slice(0, maxSlots);
                    }

                    function saveSlots(list) {
                        slots = list.slice(0, maxSlots);
                        run("sh", ["-c", "mkdir -p \"$2\" && printf '%s' \"$1\" > \"$3.tmp\" && mv \"$3.tmp\" \"$3\"",
                                   "sh", JSON.stringify(slots), dataDir, slotsFile]);
                    }

                    function addSlot(id, name) {
                        var list = slots.slice();
                        for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) if (list[i].id === id) return;
                        if (list.length >= maxSlots) return;
                        list.push({ id: id, name: name });
                        saveSlots(list);
                    }

                    function removeSlot(index) {
                        var list = slots.slice();
                        list.splice(index, 1);
                        saveSlots(list);
                    }

                    function labelFor(slot) {
                        if (!slot) return "";
                        return slot.label ? slot.label : slot.name;
                    }

                    function startRename(index) {
                        menuIndex = -1;
                        renameIndex = index;
                        draft = slots[index] ? labelFor(slots[index]) : "";
                        shiftOn = draft.length === 0;
                    }

                    function finishRename(save) {
                        if (save && renameIndex >= 0 && renameIndex < slots.length) {
                            var list = slots.slice();
                            var item = { id: list[renameIndex].id, name: list[renameIndex].name };
                            var t = draft.trim();
                            if (t.length > 0 && t !== item.name) item.label = t;
                            list[renameIndex] = item;
                            saveSlots(list);
                        }
                        renameIndex = -1;
                    }

                    function typeKey(k) {
                        if (draft.length >= maxLabel) return;
                        draft = draft + (shiftOn ? k.toUpperCase() : k);
                        shiftOn = false;
                    }

                    function closeAll() {
                        open = false;
                        menuIndex = -1;
                    }

                    // Centre the bubbles on the 45-degree line, spaced evenly.
                    function bubbleAngle(i) {
                        return Math.PI / 4 + (i - (bubbleCount - 1) / 2) * arcStep;
                    }

                    // ---------- opening a notebook ----------
                    function openDoc(id) {
                        closeAll();
                        if (typeof Library !== "undefined" && Library.entryForId && !Library.entryForId(id)) {
                            console.log("[quicknotes] document not found: " + id);
                            return;
                        }
                        try {
                            if (root.explorer && typeof root.explorer.open === "function") {
                                root.explorer.open(id);
                                return;
                            }
                        } catch (e) { console.log("[quicknotes] explorer.open failed: " + e); }
                        try {
                            root.windowNavigator.open("legacydevice/window/main", { documentId: id });
                            return;
                        } catch (e2) { console.log("[quicknotes] windowNavigator legacy route failed: " + e2); }
                        try {
                            root.windowNavigator.open("legacydevice/window/main", { id: id });
                        } catch (e3) { console.log("[quicknotes] all open routes failed: " + e3); }
                    }

                    // ---------- notebook list for the picker ----------
                    property var allDocs: []
                    property string quickNotesFolderId: ""
                    property int pickerPage: 0
                    readonly property int perPage: 8
                    readonly property var pickable: {
                        var pinned = {};
                        for (var i = 0; i < slots.length; i++) pinned[slots[i].id] = true;
                        return allDocs.filter(function (d) { return !pinned[d.id]; });
                    }
                    readonly property int pageCount: Math.max(1, Math.ceil(pickable.length / perPage))
                    readonly property var pageItems: pickable.slice(pickerPage * perPage, (pickerPage + 1) * perPage)

                    function loadDocs() {
                        var script = "cd \"$1\" || exit 0; for f in *.metadata; do "
                                   + "printf '%s\\t' \"${f%.metadata}\"; tr -d '\\n' < \"$f\"; echo; done";
                        var r = run("sh", ["-c", script, "sh", xochitlDir]);
                        var lines = (r.stdout || "").split("\n");
                        var docs = [], folders = {};
                        for (var i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
                            var tab = lines[i].indexOf("\t");
                            if (tab < 0) continue;
                            var id = lines[i].substring(0, tab);
                            var m;
                            try { m = JSON.parse(lines[i].substring(tab + 1)); } catch (e) { continue; }
                            if (!m || m.deleted || m.parent === "trash") continue;
                            if (m.type === "CollectionType") {
                                folders[id] = m.visibleName;
                                if (m.visibleName === "Quick Notes" && !m.parent) quickNotesFolderId = id;
                            }
                            else if (m.type === "DocumentType")
                                docs.push({ id: id, name: m.visibleName || "Untitled",
                                            parent: m.parent || "", modified: Number(m.lastModified || 0) });
                        }
                        for (var j = 0; j < docs.length; j++)
                            docs[j].folder = docs[j].parent ? (folders[docs[j].parent] || "") : "My files";
                        docs.sort(function (a, b) { return b.modified - a.modified; });
                        allDocs = docs;
                        pickerPage = 0;
                    }

                    function createQuickNote() {
                        if (typeof LibraryController === "undefined" || typeof Library === "undefined") {
                            console.log("[quicknotes] LibraryController not available");
                            return;
                        }
                        try {
                            var folderId = qn.quickNotesFolderId;
                            if (!folderId || !Library.entryForId(folderId))
                                folderId = Library.createCollectionWrapper("", "Quick Notes");
                            var name = "Quick note " + Qt.formatDateTime(new Date(), "MMM d h:mm AP");
                            var id = "" + LibraryController.createDocument(folderId, name);
                            if (id) {
                                addSlot(id, name);
                                pickerOpen = false;
                                openDoc(id);
                            }
                        } catch (e) {
                            console.log("[quicknotes] create failed: " + e);
                        }
                    }

                    Component.onCompleted: loadSlots()

                    // ---------- corner hotspot (finger only) ----------
                    Item {
                        id: corner
                        x: 0
                        y: qn.height - height
                        width: qn.hotspot
                        height: qn.hotspot
                        visible: (!qn.pickerOpen && qn.renameIndex < 0)

                        Rectangle {
                            width: qn.hotspot * 0.5
                            height: width
                            radius: width / 2
                            x: -width / 2
                            y: parent.height - height / 2
                            color: "transparent"
                            border.width: 2
                            border.color: "#000000"
                            opacity: qn.open ? 0 : 0.35
                        }

                        TapHandler {
                            acceptedDevices: PointerDevice.TouchScreen
                            onTapped: {
                                if (qn.open) { qn.closeAll(); }
                                else { qn.loadSlots(); qn.open = true; }
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    // ---------- tap-outside-to-close backdrop ----------
                    MouseArea {
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        visible: (qn.open && !qn.pickerOpen && qn.renameIndex < 0)
                        onClicked: { qn.closeAll(); }
                    }

                    // ---------- the fan ----------
                    Rectangle {
                        visible: (qn.open && !qn.pickerOpen && qn.renameIndex < 0)
                        width: (qn.fanRadius + qn.bubble) * 2
                        height: width
                        radius: width / 2
                        x: -width / 2
                        y: qn.height - height / 2
                        color: "#ffffff"
                        border.width: 2
                        border.color: "#000000"
                    }

                    Repeater {
                        model: (qn.open && !qn.pickerOpen && qn.renameIndex < 0) ? qn.bubbleCount : 0

                        Rectangle {
                            id: bubbleItem
                            readonly property bool isPlus: index >= qn.slots.length
                            readonly property bool isSelected: index === qn.menuIndex
                            readonly property real angle: qn.bubbleAngle(index)
                            width: qn.bubble
                            height: qn.bubble
                            radius: width / 2
                            x: qn.unit * 0.35 + qn.fanRadius * Math.cos(angle) - width / 2
                            y: qn.height - qn.unit * 0.35 - qn.fanRadius * Math.sin(angle) - height / 2
                            color: (isPlus || isSelected) ? "#ffffff" : "#000000"
                            border.width: isSelected ? 6 : 3
                            border.color: "#000000"

                            Text {
                                anchors.fill: parent
                                anchors.margins: parent.width * 0.12
                                horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
                                verticalAlignment: Text.AlignVCenter
                                wrapMode: Text.WordWrap
                                elide: Text.ElideRight
                                maximumLineCount: 2
                                font.pixelSize: bubbleItem.isPlus ? parent.width * 0.5 : parent.width * 0.17
                                color: (bubbleItem.isPlus || bubbleItem.isSelected) ? "#000000" : "#ffffff"
                                text: {
                                    if (bubbleItem.isPlus) return "+";
                                    return qn.labelFor(qn.slots[index]);
                                }
                            }

                            MouseArea {
                                anchors.fill: parent
                                onClicked: {
                                    if (qn.menuIndex >= 0) {
                                        qn.menuIndex = -1;
                                    } else if (bubbleItem.isPlus) {
                                        qn.loadDocs();
                                        qn.pickerOpen = true;
                                    } else {
                                        qn.openDoc(qn.slots[index].id);
                                    }
                                }
                                onPressAndHold: {
                                    if (!bubbleItem.isPlus) { qn.menuIndex = index; }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    // ---------- long-press menu: Rename / Remove ----------
                    Rectangle {
                        id: bubbleMenu
                        visible: (qn.open && qn.menuIndex >= 0 && qn.renameIndex < 0 && !qn.pickerOpen)
                        width: qn.unit * 4.2
                        height: menuColumn.height + qn.unit * 0.6
                        x: qn.fanRadius + qn.bubble * 1.4
                        y: qn.height - height - qn.unit * 0.6
                        radius: qn.unit * 0.2
                        color: "#ffffff"
                        border.width: 3
                        border.color: "#000000"

                        MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent }

                        Column {
                            id: menuColumn
                            anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
                            anchors.top: parent.top
                            anchors.topMargin: qn.unit * 0.3
                            width: parent.width - qn.unit * 0.6
                            spacing: qn.unit * 0.2

                            Text {
                                width: parent.width
                                horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
                                elide: Text.ElideRight
                                text: qn.labelFor(qn.slots[qn.menuIndex])
                                font.pixelSize: qn.unit * 0.32
                                color: "#000000"
                            }
                            Repeater {
                                model: ["Rename", "Remove", "Cancel"]
                                Rectangle {
                                    width: menuColumn.width
                                    height: qn.unit * 0.8
                                    radius: height / 2
                                    color: index === 0 ? "#000000" : "#ffffff"
                                    border.width: 2
                                    border.color: "#000000"
                                    Text {
                                        anchors.centerIn: parent
                                        text: modelData
                                        font.pixelSize: qn.unit * 0.3
                                        color: index === 0 ? "#ffffff" : "#000000"
                                    }
                                    MouseArea {
                                        anchors.fill: parent
                                        onClicked: {
                                            var i = qn.menuIndex;
                                            if (index === 0) { qn.startRename(i); }
                                            else if (index === 1) { qn.menuIndex = -1; qn.removeSlot(i); }
                                            else { qn.menuIndex = -1; }
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    // ---------- rename editor with built-in keyboard ----------
                    Rectangle {
                        id: renameEditor
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        visible: qn.renameIndex >= 0
                        color: "#ffffff"

                        MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent }

                        Column {
                            anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
                            anchors.top: parent.top
                            anchors.topMargin: qn.unit * 0.8
                            width: parent.width - qn.unit
                            spacing: qn.unit * 0.3

                            Text {
                                width: parent.width
                                text: "Rename bubble"
                                font.pixelSize: qn.unit * 0.4
                                color: "#000000"
                            }
                            Text {
                                width: parent.width
                                elide: Text.ElideRight
                                text: "Notebook: " + (qn.slots[qn.renameIndex] ? qn.slots[qn.renameIndex].name : "")
                                font.pixelSize: qn.unit * 0.26
                                color: "#555555"
                            }
                            Rectangle {
                                width: parent.width
                                height: qn.unit * 1.0
                                radius: qn.unit * 0.12
                                border.width: 3
                                border.color: "#000000"
                                Text {
                                    anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                                    anchors.left: parent.left
                                    anchors.leftMargin: qn.unit * 0.3
                                    text: qn.draft + "|"
                                    font.pixelSize: qn.unit * 0.42
                                    color: "#000000"
                                }
                            }
                            Text {
                                width: parent.width
                                text: "Leave it empty to use the notebook name. " + qn.draft.length + "/" + qn.maxLabel
                                font.pixelSize: qn.unit * 0.24
                                color: "#555555"
                            }
                        }

                        Column {
                            id: keyboard
                            anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
                            anchors.bottom: parent.bottom
                            anchors.bottomMargin: qn.unit * 0.6
                            spacing: qn.unit * 0.15
                            readonly property real keyW: Math.min(qn.width / 11, qn.unit * 0.9)
                            readonly property real keyH: qn.unit * 0.95

                            Repeater {
                                model: ["1234567890", "qwertyuiop", "asdfghjkl", "zxcvbnm-'"]
                                Row {
                                    id: keyRow
                                    property string rowKeys: modelData
                                    anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
                                    spacing: keyboard.keyW * 0.08
                                    Repeater {
                                        model: keyRow.rowKeys.split("")
                                        Rectangle {
                                            width: keyboard.keyW
                                            height: keyboard.keyH
                                            radius: qn.unit * 0.1
                                            border.width: 2
                                            border.color: "#000000"
                                            Text {
                                                anchors.centerIn: parent
                                                text: qn.shiftOn ? modelData.toUpperCase() : modelData
                                                font.pixelSize: qn.unit * 0.38
                                                color: "#000000"
                                            }
                                            MouseArea {
                                                anchors.fill: parent
                                                onClicked: { qn.typeKey(modelData); }
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }

                            Row {
                                anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
                                spacing: keyboard.keyW * 0.08
                                Repeater {
                                    model: ["Shift", "Space", "Del", "Clear", "Cancel", "Done"]
                                    Rectangle {
                                        width: modelData === "Space" ? keyboard.keyW * 3 : keyboard.keyW * 1.35
                                        height: keyboard.keyH
                                        radius: qn.unit * 0.1
                                        color: (modelData === "Done" || (modelData === "Shift" && qn.shiftOn)) ? "#000000" : "#ffffff"
                                        border.width: 2
                                        border.color: "#000000"
                                        Text {
                                            anchors.centerIn: parent
                                            text: modelData
                                            font.pixelSize: qn.unit * 0.26
                                            color: (modelData === "Done" || (modelData === "Shift" && qn.shiftOn)) ? "#ffffff" : "#000000"
                                        }
                                        MouseArea {
                                            anchors.fill: parent
                                            onClicked: {
                                                if (modelData === "Shift") { qn.shiftOn = !qn.shiftOn; }
                                                else if (modelData === "Space") { if (qn.draft.length < qn.maxLabel) { qn.draft = qn.draft + " "; } }
                                                else if (modelData === "Del") { qn.draft = qn.draft.slice(0, -1); }
                                                else if (modelData === "Clear") { qn.draft = ""; qn.shiftOn = true; }
                                                else if (modelData === "Cancel") { qn.finishRename(false); }
                                                else { qn.finishRename(true); }
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    // ---------- notebook picker (paged, E Ink friendly) ----------
                    Rectangle {
                        id: picker
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        visible: qn.pickerOpen
                        color: "#ffffff"

                        MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent }

                        Column {
                            anchors.fill: parent
                            anchors.margins: qn.unit * 0.5
                            spacing: qn.unit * 0.2

                            Item {
                                width: parent.width
                                height: qn.unit * 0.9
                                Text {
                                    anchors.left: parent.left
                                    anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                                    text: "Pin a notebook (" + qn.slots.length + "/" + qn.maxSlots + ")"
                                    font.pixelSize: qn.unit * 0.4
                                    color: "#000000"
                                }
                                Rectangle {
                                    anchors.right: parent.right
                                    anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                                    width: qn.unit * 1.6
                                    height: qn.unit * 0.75
                                    radius: height / 2
                                    border.width: 2
                                    border.color: "#000000"
                                    Text { anchors.centerIn: parent; text: "Cancel"; font.pixelSize: qn.unit * 0.3; color: "#000000" }
                                    MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent; onClicked: { qn.pickerOpen = false; } }
                                }
                            }

                            Rectangle {
                                width: parent.width
                                height: qn.unit * 0.9
                                radius: qn.unit * 0.15
                                color: "#000000"
                                visible: (typeof LibraryController !== "undefined")
                                Text {
                                    anchors.centerIn: parent
                                    text: "+ New note in \"Quick Notes\" folder"
                                    font.pixelSize: qn.unit * 0.32
                                    color: "#ffffff"
                                }
                                MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent; onClicked: qn.createQuickNote() }
                            }

                            Repeater {
                                model: qn.pageItems
                                Rectangle {
                                    width: parent.width
                                    height: qn.unit * 1.05
                                    color: "#ffffff"
                                    border.width: 1
                                    border.color: "#000000"
                                    radius: qn.unit * 0.12
                                    Column {
                                        anchors.left: parent.left
                                        anchors.right: parent.right
                                        anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                                        anchors.leftMargin: qn.unit * 0.3
                                        anchors.rightMargin: qn.unit * 0.3
                                        Text {
                                            width: parent.width
                                            text: modelData.name
                                            elide: Text.ElideRight
                                            font.pixelSize: qn.unit * 0.34
                                            color: "#000000"
                                        }
                                        Text {
                                            width: parent.width
                                            text: modelData.folder
                                            elide: Text.ElideRight
                                            font.pixelSize: qn.unit * 0.24
                                            color: "#555555"
                                        }
                                    }
                                    MouseArea {
                                        anchors.fill: parent
                                        onClicked: {
                                            qn.addSlot(modelData.id, modelData.name);
                                            qn.pickerOpen = false;
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }

                        Row {
                            anchors.bottom: parent.bottom
                            anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
                            anchors.bottomMargin: qn.unit * 0.5
                            spacing: qn.unit * 0.5

                            Rectangle {
                                width: qn.unit * 1.6; height: qn.unit * 0.75; radius: height / 2
                                border.width: 2; border.color: "#000000"
                                opacity: qn.pickerPage > 0 ? 1 : 0.3
                                Text { anchors.centerIn: parent; text: "Prev"; font.pixelSize: qn.unit * 0.3; color: "#000000" }
                                MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent; onClicked: { if (qn.pickerPage > 0) qn.pickerPage--; } }
                            }
                            Text {
                                anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                                text: (qn.pickerPage + 1) + " / " + qn.pageCount
                                font.pixelSize: qn.unit * 0.3
                                color: "#000000"
                            }
                            Rectangle {
                                width: qn.unit * 1.6; height: qn.unit * 0.75; radius: height / 2
                                border.width: 2; border.color: "#000000"
                                opacity: qn.pickerPage < qn.pageCount - 1 ? 1 : 0.3
                                Text { anchors.centerIn: parent; text: "Next"; font.pixelSize: qn.unit * 0.3; color: "#000000" }
                                MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent; onClicked: { if (qn.pickerPage < qn.pageCount - 1) qn.pickerPage++; } }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
